title: docs: report missing community model usage to owners
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Ask providers for missing token counts using short, correctly attributed Discord messages.
- Track consecutive billing flags and a separate 24-hour posting cooldown.
- Distinguish unbilled complete answers from real terminal stream errors before health actions.
- Instruction-only change; existing chat-stream tests pass (4/4).

gist.headline: The hive counts its pollen
gist.blurb: The community monitor now has clearer instructions for asking model owners about missing token counts, without mistaking a finished answer for a broken stream. Even the bookkeeping gets a little less buzzy.
gist.summary: Updated the community-monitor runbook to send short, correctly attributed Discord notices for missing provider token usage, track consecutive billing flags separately from a 24-hour posting cooldown, and avoid health actions for unbilled completed streams.
gist.impact: Model providers receive more precise, rate-limited usage follow-ups while completed chat responses are less likely to be treated as terminal stream failures.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden bookkeeping scene: Polli, wearing tiny accountant glasses, checks a pollen ledger beside a retro terminal showing token-count rows, while a small mail pigeon carries one carefully timed Discord note. A healthy code-plant blooms nearby to represent correctly recognized completed streams rather than false alarms.
